phase_keywords: Navigate to the trending/week page, scroll to products ranked 25-35, and collect each product's name, detail page URL, and rank.

Go to https://theresanaiforthat.com/trending/week/. The page lists AI products in rank order. Scroll down until products ranked 25 through 35 are visible and materialized in the DOM. For each product in ranks 25-35 inclusive, record: (1) rank as shown on the page, (2) product name as visible text, (3) the full absolute URL to the product's detail page. Stop after collecting all 11 products (ranks 25-35). If the page lazy-loads, keep scrolling until all 11 are found. If less than 35 products are available, collect whatever is available in that range and report the actual count.

phase_keywords: For each product collected in phase 1 (ranks 25-35), visit its detail page and extract reviews, pros & cons, and Q&A details.

You are given an artifact containing product listing data (ranks 25-35) with detail URLs. For each product, navigate to its detailUrl, wait for the page to settle, and extract: (1) Reviews - all user reviews with reviewer name, rating, date, and review text; (2) Pros & Cons - pros list and cons list as shown on the page; (3) Q&A - all questions and answers with question text, answer text, and any metadata like dates or asker/answerer names. After collecting all detail data for all products, return the combined results. If a detail page does not have reviews/pros-cons/QA sections, note them as empty/absent with evidence.
